description: Agora BFF capability manifest v1.6 - persona-to-persona opinion consultation, governed action authority event contracts (PINT-001), and 12-block Winner Branch completeness contract (AG-GAP-012). This is a contract freeze only: no new BFF/OpenAPI routes are introduced by this manifest.

capabilities.name: agora.persona.opinion_consultation.v1
capabilities.description: Cross-repo event contract for persona-to-persona opinion consultation, operationalizing PERSONA_RUNTIME_MODEL.md section 13 (requester / responder / committee_participant roles) as SessionPersona-mediated events. Distinct from services/consultation's ConsultRequest/ConsultMemo formal governance-review workflow; may escalate into one via escalated_consult_request_id.

capabilities.name: agora.persona.governed_action_authority.v1
capabilities.description: Cross-repo event contract that closes persona action authority, operationalizing PERSONA_RUNTIME_MODEL.md section 6 Consult Policy (required reviewers/committees, trigger rules, forbidden solo actions, escalation rules). Records the persona-owned solo_eligibility evaluation and the governance-owned decision outcome; never executes the underlying command.

capabilities.name: agora.winner_branch.completeness.v1
capabilities.description: Cross-repo contract defining the 12 named Winner Branch block completeness assessment, mapped compatibly to the 7 generic completeness dimensions.

governance_owned: decision on GovernedActionAuthorityRequest (authorized / authorized_with_conditions / denied / escalated)
domain_service_owned: command execution once decision is authorized or authorized_with_conditions

note: The v1.6 surface is additive over v1.5 and freezes three new schemas/contracts. It does not authorize direct trading actions, deployment, rollback, broker, or capital actions, and it does not itself execute the governed action. BFF wiring / route implementation is out of scope for this freeze and is tracked as follow-up execution work.
